newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in lower OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in lower OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin, including its Osijek outpost for Friday, October 25.
* Of 12 active issues three were up, two fell and seven were unchanged.
* Volume lower at 1,451 shares, turnover also down at 80,100 kuna.
* 10-stock VIN index fell to 8.653 from 8.753 points.
* Biggest gainer was liquor producer Badel 1862, 60 percent up to 40 German marks with 50 shares sold.
* Hotelier Istraturist, the bigger of two decliners, lost 16.7 percent to 50 marks on volume of 89 units.
* The most actively traded issue was electronic firm Ericsson Tesla, trading 349 shares, closing flat at 50 marks.
* Trading results are also available on page OTCV on week days. -- Zagreb newsroom, 385-1-455707
